notes.title: Verson 1.1
notes.notes:
----- Game Version 1.1 -----

[i]Major Changes[/i]:
[olist]
[*] The time taken to complete the game is significantly reduced.
[*] The Steam Achievements linked to the completion of the game are updated too.
[/olist]

Note: The achievements "You are a Level Rusher" and "YOU ACHIEVED 100% COMPLETION OF THE GAME" are linked to the time that is spent by the player on the game.

[i]Minor Changes[/i]:
[olist]
[*] The Cursor Color is changed to make it contrast differently with the different backgrounds that is shown in all of the levels in the game.
[/olist]
